thread:
kai: opening thread to finalize the safeguard pivot orchestration and operator handoff. main constraints: no cache stampedes, auditable decisions, reversible with one click.
mira: quick constraints list: leases short by default, signed control-plane overrides, and a graceful ramp to avoid cold-cache spikes.
omar: propose "lease ladder": proxy (5-15s), regional (30-120s), control-plane persistent (>=5m). proxies can do local quick pivots but must log acquisition.
viv: signals: p95 latency, 5xx%, model_quality_delta. require >=2 signals and min 30 requests in window to trigger local pivot. add exponential backoff per-session.
kai: operator handoff items: 1) console revert button that force-sets variant and clears leases, 2) pivot timeline, 3) audit showing which proxy issued lease, 4) quick CLI: `rctl rollouts revert --id <id> --force`.
ops-bot: note: metric pipeline updated to emit quality_delta for canaries. :white_check_mark:
mira: security: decisions carry KMS-signed tokens and idempotency keys; proxies reject unsigned or expired decisions.
omar: test plan: staging chaos that injects 5xx and quality drop; assert pivot latency < lease_s and no >2x tail-latency spike.
kai: next: i'll PR the policy proto + runbook, mira handles signing design, viv prototypes dashboard. review Thurs 14:00.
